description: US-41 — THE AUSGABE SCREEN REDESIGNED so the whole counter fits ONE SCREEN WITHOUT SCROLLING on DF's MacBook Air (1440 × 800). The seven stacked cards of /ausgabe (session header, group tally, lookup, verdict banner, household details, certificate controls, payment, danger zone) become: a HEADER LINE (date · KW, group badge(s), „x von y Haushalten abgeholt", Ausgabetermine, Ausgabe beenden), ONE „AUSGABEMASKE" card on a 12-col grid, and the FULL LIST of the session's households below it with the Kundenliste's columns plus „Heute". Principle: EVERY STATE SWAPS CONTENT IN A FIXED PLACE — no state adds a card. „Ausgabe erfassen" sits BESIDE the lookup; „Ausgabe frei" shows NO chip (the green button is the signal); every exception shows ONE chip beside the button. „Gezahlt (von 4,00 €)" is one field in the tile row. Certificate renewal and note editing happen IN PLACE; remove/block/archive open in the FOOTER. An edited but un-looked-up number DISABLES booking (decision 1). NO RULE CHANGES: verdicts, price, balance, reminders, campaign and audit stay as they are; only three derived read fields, one roster use case and an isoWeek helper are added. The LOOK is the Design canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/SKRE5hmzii8WrkrNxrvsbP (read with the Artifact tool, never WebFetch); the BEHAVIOUR is tasks/prd-us-41-counter-screen-redesign.md. Each UI story migrates the e2e specs it breaks; both engines stay green.
